title: On Conjectures of $μ$-Invariant for Selmer Groups at $p=2$
summary: Let $E$ be an elliptic curve define over $\mathbb{Q}$. Further assume $E$ has good ordinary reduction at $p=2$. In this article, we prove Greenberg's conjecture on the value of the algebraic Iwasawa $μ$-invariant when $E$ has a rational isogeny of degree 2, and obtain a sharp absolute upper bound of the $2$-adic $μ$-invariants for all such curves. We also prove the vanishing of the algebraic $μ$-invariant of the fine Selmer group introduced by Coates and Sujatha at $p=2$.
